prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Pick the sensor(s) that hold today's and tomorrow's prices (Nord Pool, ENTSO-e, Energi Data Service, Tibber-style templates or the official Nord Pool integration). Forecast sensors with the same kind of list are optional.

data_description.price_entities: Sensors with a price list attribute (for example raw_today/raw_tomorrow or data). Several sensors are merged.
data_description.forecast_entities: Used to wait for a clearly cheaper day. Forecast slots are never charged, only compared.
data_description.reference_entity: The relative price limit is a share of this value. Without it Simple Charge uses its own rolling average of the price sensor.

charger.title: Charger
charger.description: How should Simple Charge start and stop the charger? Choose 'Only plan' if you want to use the Charge now sensor in your own automations.

data_description.limiter_switch: Turned off before charging starts and back on when it stops (for example a Garo charge limiter).

select_options.title: Select options
select_options.description: Which option charges, and which option means 'not now'? For Garo: ALWAYS_ON and SCHEMA.

advanced.title: Fine tuning (optional)
advanced.description: The defaults work for most people. Battery level and Garo schedule are optional.

data_description.hysteresis_pct: A slot that is already charging may cost this much more than the limit before it stops.
data_description.forecast_margin_pct: Forecast prices are made this much more expensive before they are compared, so only a clearly cheaper day makes it wait.
data_description.max_wait_hours: After this long without a charge the forecast is ignored and the cheapest known slots are used.
data_description.soc_entity: With battery level, size and power set, the charging time is calculated from the target level instead of the fixed duration.
data_description.garo_schedule_entity: Writes the plan into the Garo box's own schedule (garo_wallbox integration), so it still charges when Wi-Fi drops. Simple Charge then owns that schedule.

error.no_prices: None of these sensors has a price list Simple Charge understands.
